newsitem.title: UK: Higher sellers sidelined UK meals and feeds buyers.
newsitem.headline: Higher sellers sidelined UK meals and feeds buyers.

text.p: Higher asking prices following the firm close overnight in Chicago sidelined most buyers on the UK meals and feeds market on Friday.
"Chicago has been all over the place this week and most people have decided to leave the market alone until Monday and hope things settle down a bit," said one broker.
High protein soymeal was as much as three stg up from the Mill and 4.50 stg higher ex-store.
Rapemeal sellers were one stg higher at all the mills while corn gluten feed pellets were two stg up to unchanged and sunflower pellets and meal one stg above Thursday levels.
